text:
Chiaroscuro, the river sings!

How does it come so playfully?

And the leaves with dew

are green eyes crying!


What celestial music

is heard in these places;

murmurings of banana groves

and of wild doves!


Among the mountain fineries

everything is a lyre:

the turtle-dove that sighs

is a madrigal with wings!

translation.title: Plumbago
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the bright musical pastoral of river, grove, and dove.
